jchen: Quick sync — I sketched an experiment called 'lookahead-handoff' (two-pass decode: cheap lookahead + selective re-roll) for draft-model bring-up. Offline sims look promising: ~1.8–2.0x throughput on smaller quant models, ~1.5x on large 70b q4 variants. Quality hit is small but concentrated in long-coherence tasks (~0.3–0.5 relative on our rerank metric). Need ops + eval sign-off to run a canary.

marie: Can you drop the notes/link? :eyes:

jchen: Pasted quick notes below — TL;DR, eval plan, and initial numbers. Will push artifacts to /shared/onboard/lookahead after initial review.

jchen: What
- Goal: reduce per-token servable cost while keeping coherent longform quality.
- Idea: run a low-cost lookahead pass (short prefix sampling / cheap kv reuse) to prefetch likely token continuations, then do a focused second pass (re-roll) only when lookahead confidence is low.
- Why: many beams/sampling attempts repeat similar KV work, and a cheap lookahead allows us to skip full decoder iterations most of the time.

jchen: How (ops sketch)
- Lookahead width: L=4 tokens, keep top-K partial traces (K small, e.g., 2).
- Scoring: cheap unigram+cache-score proxy to estimate if re-roll needed.
- Second pass: full-quality decode only on traces with low proxy score.
- Implementation notes: reuse KV cache across lookahead and second pass where possible, avoid full model reload.

jchen: Eval plan
- Datasets: longform-coherence (4k prompts), summarization (2k), chat-safety (1k).
- Metrics: rerank-based coherence score, ROUGE/BERTopic for summarization, safety classifier false-positive rate.
- Repeats: 3 seeds for each run, sample sizes >= 5k tokens per prompt mix for stable stats.

jchen: Initial numbers (offline simulation, mixed workloads):
```
Model    | tokens/s (baseline) | tokens/s (lookahead) | rel
rlh-13b-q| 1200                | 2200                 | 1.83x
rlh-70b-q| 320                 | 480                  | 1.50x
```
jchen: Quality delta (rerank metric, lower is worse):
- rlh-13b-q: +0.32 (worse)
- rlh-70b-q: +0.48 (worse on very long prompts only)
- Std across 3 seeds: ~0.03

akumar: Nice sketch. A few q's: how stable are the tradeoffs across prompt length distribution? did you try varying L?

jchen: Tested L in {2,4,6}. L=4 gave best cost-quality frontier on our mix; L=2 was cheaper but higher miss-rate (more re-rolls), L=6 reduced misses but increased wasted compute. Longer prompts push up the quality delta slightly because lookahead proxy has less context.

lgarcia: What about p99 per-request latency? this sounds batching-friendly but could hurt tail.

jchen: Good point — batch simulations show median token latency is similar, but p99 per-request increases ~12% on baseline autoscale due to occasional re-rolls. Plan: use fastpath routing for latency-sensitive routes (no lookahead) and enable lookahead on throughput-heavy routes.

ben: We should add a hallucination/safety check — small quality regressions may hide safety issues. Please run the safety classifier and a small human rater sweep before canary.

jchen: Agreed. Will add safety classifier pass in eval pipeline and request human raters for ~200 long prompts.

marie: I can own the human eval if you push results to /shared/onboard/lookahead. Also can run a focused A/B on our flagship customer use-case.

akumar: Also request: include seed variance and sample size in the artifact (csv + small analysis notebook). I'll expand the seed runs to 5 if compute allows.

opsbot: deploy-bot: Canary job queued: onboard-lookahead-v1 on dedicated-ops pool (ETA 2026-03-24 17:00 UTC).

jchen: Action items
- jchen: push artifacts (eval logs, sample traces, code diff) to /shared/onboard/lookahead by EOD.
- akumar: extend seed runs / produce variance table.
- lgarcia: prepare dedicated model config for canary (routing + fallback rules).
- marie: run human eval + customer A/B after artifacts are up.
- ben: define safety checklist for canary (classifier thresholds + stop criteria).

jchen: Quick snippet for running the offline harness (local):
```
python tools/onboard_eval.py --model rlh-13b-q --decode lookahead-handoff --lookahead 4 --k 2 --samples 6 --batch 32 --out /tmp/lookahead-run
```

marie: I'll review artifacts tomorrow morning. thanks for the clear sketch. :thumbsup: :party_parrot:

jchen: Thanks all — ping me here for blockers.
